text:
maria: Heads up — p50 latency for seqlen<=32 jumped ~2.2x on Dedicated after the autotune merge last night. Seeing a lot of 'autotune_mismatch' picks in runtime telemetry. Posting a small tail of the logs below

kevin: Can you paste the telemetry lines? Any obvious kernel flip or KV cache churn?

maria: Quick dump from the request sampler (sanitized):

```
[telemetry] ts=2025-03-12T07:12:08Z pick=matmul_v2 reason=autotune_mismatch arch=x86_64 seq_bucket=short score=0.324 fallback=arch-aware-fused flags="RKERNEL_AUTOTUNE=1 RKERNEL_DEBUG=0"
[telemetry] ts=2025-03-12T07:12:08Z pick=matmul_v2 reason=autotune_mismatch arch=x86_64 seq_bucket=short chosen_by=autotune_model_v2 model_version=20250311
[cache]    ts=2025-03-12T07:12:08Z kv_hit=false prefix_key=usr:ctx:abcd size_est=0 req_id=6b3a
[perf]     ts=2025-03-12T07:12:08Z p50_ms=18 p95_ms=42 seqlen=24 batch=1 kernels=[matmul_v2]
```

maria: Note: prior to the merge picks were 'arch-aware-fused' for these samples and p50 was ~8ms.

oliver: If the reason field is 'autotune_mismatch' it means the new scoring net overrode the rule-based selector. Try forcing the legacy selector via RKERNEL_AUTOTUNE_OVERRIDE=1 and re-run one sample.

anya: Also saw KV cache hit-rate dip on the same traffic slice overnight — could be batching boundary changes + different kernel memory layout causing cache invalidations.

kevin: Can you share the exact command to reproduce locally? I'll run the profiler on my machine.

maria: repro command I used:
```
RKERNEL_DEBUG=1 RKERNEL_AUTOTUNE_OVERRIDE=1 ./run-infer --model strat-v3 --seq 24 --batch 1 --profile /tmp/trace.json
```
Ran that with override and p50 dropped back to ~9ms (matching pre-merge). With autotune enabled p50 goes back up to ~18ms.

oliver: Sounds like a scoring calibration problem — the autotuner is favoring matmul_v2 for short seqs on x86 because it predicts throughput, but it isn't accounting for KV cache locality and prefix reuse. We should add a term for cache_penalty to the score.

kevin: Agreed. Two immediate asks: 1) Add a discrete telemetry tag 'autotune_source' that is one of [model_v1, model_v2, rule_based, override] instead of free text. 2) Emit cache_hit_rate and local_prefix_size in the pick record so we can query historical impact.

maria: Filed a short PR with a sample telemetry schema patch, but would like to capture more fields before merging.

oliver: I'll open an issue for a cache-aware scoring term and flag to disable the new scorer per-arch. Created issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/issues/3421 :eyes:

devbot: deploy-bot: Canary deploy of autotune-model-v2 -> finished (canary 10%) :rocket:

sre-bot: alert: increased latency on /v1/generate (resolved) :white_check_mark:

maria: TL;DR — autotune_model_v2 is selecting a kernel that regresses short-sequence latency because it doesn't account for KV cache locality. Workitems: schema fields, cache term in scorer, temporary override flag on per-arch selector.

anya: Will dig into batching heuristics next — I think some requests shifted buckets which amplified the effect.

kevin: I'll run a broader sampler across regions and post a small histogram tomorrow AM. :+1:

maria: Thanks all. React with :thumbsup: if you're aligned or ping me for follow-ups.
